cohorts.label: Travelling — booking offline
cohorts.insight: Ticketed bookings exist in Lumina, made by a consultant. No Melon login, ever. These people already travel — they simply never met the platform.
cohorts.treatment: Activate with their own booking history as the proof point.
cohorts.channel: Mel push → MCAE email → consultant task in Workspace
cohorts.value: Highest. Every one of these is an existing traveller and a recoverable service cost.

cohorts.label: Logged in once, never returned
cohorts.insight: A single Melon session in the first fortnight, then nothing. Onboarding started and did not land.
cohorts.treatment: Restart onboarding at the step they abandoned, not from the beginning.
cohorts.channel: In-app resume prompt → MCAE email → self-serve walkthrough
cohorts.value: High. Intent was already demonstrated once.

cohorts.label: Mel app only, never the platform
cohorts.insight: Installed Mel, asks in-trip questions, opts into push — but has never booked on the web platform.
cohorts.treatment: Bridge the surfaces. Nudge inside Mel, where they already are.
cohorts.channel: Mel in-app card → deep link into Melon booking flow
cohorts.value: Medium. Engaged already, just on one surface.
cohorts.logic:
Mel.AppInstalled = TRUE
AND Mel.SessionsL90 > 0
AND Melon.Sessions = 0

cohorts.label: No travel activity at all
cohorts.insight: On the Workday roster, but zero bookings in Lumina, no profile in Agent Port, no trips planned. Site-based and office staff who do not travel.
cohorts.treatment: Do not nudge. Suppress from the programme entirely and stop counting them against adoption.
cohorts.channel: None. Suppression list written back to Melon and MCAE.
cohorts.value: Nudging these people costs goodwill and makes the adoption number lie.
cohorts.logic:
Lumina.TicketedBookings = 0
AND AgentPort.TravellerProfile IS NULL
AND Melon.Searches = 0
